verdict.rationale: Codex supports git-based checkpoints ('Create Git checkpoints before and after a task so you can revert changes'), diff/summary review before merging, and a dedicated review command against commits or branches — giving a de facto version/review/rollback loop via git and PRs. However, this is generic code-change versioning, not a dedicated versioning/history/rollback system for 'automations' (skills, workflows, MCP configs) as distinct artifacts. Missing for 10: explicit version history or rollback UI for skills/plugins/automation configs themselves, audit trail of automation runs, and independent confirmation the checkpoint/revert feature works reliably in practice.
